name: Pallas: A JAX kernel DSL
notes: Pallas is a JAX kernel DSL for writing custom TPU and GPU kernels. Provides a programming model for writing high-performance kernels in JAX. NOTE: The original URL (github.com/jax-ml/jax/blob/main/jax/experimental/pallas/README.md) returns 404 - the file has been moved. The Pallas documentation is now at docs.jax.dev. | DEAD-LINK VERIFIED 2026-10-04. THREE independent GET probes (browser UA, curl UA, and a re-check spaced minutes later) each returned HTTP 404 'File not found'. GitHub's own API confirms the directory still exists but no longer contains README.md: api.github.com/repos/jax-ml/jax/contents/jax/experimental/pallas now lists __init__.py, fuser.py, g3doc, mosaic_gpu.py, ops, tpu.py, tpu_sc.py, triton.py - no README. So the DOC moved into docs (docs.jax.dev), as the existing note already suspected. A dead URL is information, not a reason to delete: the Pallas-is-a-JAX-kernel-DSL claim was true when read.
